text: Arrow's theorem, the Folk Theorems, and Incomplete Contract Theory together constitute a proof that rule stability is institutionally self-defeating, so the framework builds a system that governs its own evolution rather than aspiring to a stable rule set.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6819121

isBasedOn.name: The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis

abstract: Together, the three results constitute a proof that rule stability is institutionally self-defeating. The framework's response is to build a system that governs its own evolution rather than a system that aspires to a stable rule set that the three theorems show cannot exist.
